name: MemCachier
line: Managed Memcached-compatible cache for sessions, counters, and query results.

free.text: 25MB; 10 connections; disabled after 30 idle days; data retention unclear

cells.metered: Basic from about $14/mo; Heroku 1 GB cap is $70/mo
cells.regions: AWS and DigitalOcean clusters; availability unclear

sql.math: $70 is the cap for a full billing cycle on the cache plan. The 5 GB of transfer, and whether the data fits after key overhead, are unknown.
The $70 cap for a full billing cycle continues while the cache is provisioned, even with zero traffic. Whether 1 GB of data fits is not verified.

files.math: MemCachier is a cache, not durable file storage.

jobs.math: MemCachier does not run background jobs
